sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.614 of 2023, under Section 304B, 498A IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. PGI, District Lucknow.
3. It is argued that the father-in-law has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 11.03.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2690 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.2690 of 2024

The applicant is the mother-in-law.

sentences.text:
Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
5. Considering the fact that the allegations against the applicant are similar to the co-accused who has been granted bail coupled with the fact that the applicant is a lady and has no criminal history,
the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Malti Devi Alias Malti Devi Yadav be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
